I'm trying to avoid too much confrontation on Twitter these days but it's probably worth asking yourself whether these testimonials to Newsom's electability come from people who thought Kamala Harris and the 2024 version of Joe Biden were strong candidates.

The redistricting thing was smart by Newsom, and consequential, there's just no particular evidence that he swung the polls much on it as it was popular in a very blue state pretty much from the moment that voters were aware of what the ballot initiative did.


Neera Tanden🌻 (@neeratanden)

Politics is about making an argument - and Newsom just moved California 20 points on the redistricting initiative, an initiative that was running behind or even, depending on the poll,  when it started.  News
Well, either the Knicks are going to the Finals or this is gonna be an S-Tier setup for a future "30 for 30".

The ghostwriter thing is way too common, largely tolerated in the industry when it shouldn't be, needs much better disclosure at a bare minimum. I'm old fashioned and think if your name is on the cover, the thesis and the writing should be truly yours.

How do you not double-check information provided by AI in a book about AI called The Future of Truth?!? There's no deeper story here except that Rosenbaum is lazy af and/or hired a ghostwriter.


Will Oremus (@WillOremus)

I talked to the author of the "Future of Truth" book that turned out to have AI hallucinations. He told me he feels "seduced and betrayed" by ChatGPT, at one point suggesting it might have undermined him on purpose.

See below for a guide with some tips based on what's become a pretty decent track record there.

I think it's going to be hard to distinguish "AI discovered this" from "humans discovered this, via expertly directed use of very powerful computing technology". But the biases probably run toward claiming the former when the latter will usually be closer to the truth *for now*.

The combination in the DNC report of 1) extremely obvious, toothless conclusions 2)  regurgitation of random off-topic factoids and 3) lack of specific sourcing feels very much like someone didn't do the reading and used GPT/Claude.


Hunter📈🌈📊 (@StatisticUrban)

The DNC finally released the full 192 page 2024 election autopsy today.

I haven't read the whole thing, but I did read "What Happened" and it's very clear why the DNC did not release it. It's not Gaza/Palestine - that is not mentioned
SGA is like -400 to be remembered as the most underrated player 20 years from now by basketball hipsters.

I mean NorCal is probably 2x-3x underpopulated given that it has like literally the 100/100 SimCity map.


Antonio García Martínez (agm.eth) (@antoniogm)

NorCal/SF actually has the world's best weather. Cool and sunny in summer, mild in winter. You can hit a desert that will kill you and a snowy mountaintop on the same day, and go surfing the next day too. 

You can shit on the rest, but you can't contest it's a natural paradise.

Nate's 3 rules for constitutional hardball. A “democracy agenda” should be principled, create a stable equilibrium, and pass muster with voters.
On redistricting, Democrats are playing as the away team. Democrats are fighting uphill against Republican-leaning courts. But they can’t afford either despondence or complacency.
How we calculate our PELE ratings. Way more detail than you asked for on the methods behind our new soccer model.

Want more Black representatives? Elect more Democrats.. I ran the numbers on redistricting after the Supreme Court's decision on the Voting Rights Act. The Black representation trade-off is mostly a myth.
Democrats are not OK with Boomers. Perhaps having learned their lesson with Joe Biden, the party’s voters are starting to reject older, establishment-bound candidates.
